title: Backtrader-Bench：基于自生成多项选择题的算法交易LLM智能体基准测试
summary: Backtrader-Bench提出双管道框架评估算法交易中的LLM编码智能体：确定性MCQ管道从回测配置生成问题并独立验证，生成器-求解器过滤管道自动挖掘难题。工具增强智能体单次准确率达90%，远超无工具基线（73%）。该框架还可生成训练语料，用于强化学习构建量化交易专用智能体。
summary_en: Backtrader-Bench presents a dual-pipeline framework to evaluate LLM coding agents in algorithmic trading: a deterministic MCQ pipeline generates verified questions from backtest configs, and a generator-solver filtering pipeline mines harder questions. Tool-augmented agents reach 90% accuracy, outperforming no-tool baselines (73%). The framework also produces training data for RL.
